solution: Defined data models, RLS, and access methods in `omnichannel_repo.rs`. Added gRPC API to `hub.proto`. Created `MyChatService` in `src/server/services/chat/service.rs` to implement the `OmnichannelChatService` and handle chat interactions. Modified `unified_ws.rs` to make `get_broadcast_tx()` public to broadcast messages securely from the service. Modified `server/lib.rs` to inject `OmniChannelRepo` and `OHCJobQueue` and register `MyChatService` with the gRPC router.
